question: JavaScript is a(n) ____________ language.
explanation: JavaScript code is executed directly line-by-line by an interpreter without prior compilation.

question: Select the correct method name of the String object:
explanation: charAt() returns the character at a specified index in a string.

question: The ____________ method of the window object displays a message box with OK and Cancel buttons.
explanation: confirm() displays a modal dialog with OK and Cancel options.

question: Variables in JavaScript can be declared using the ____________ keyword.
explanation: var (along with let and const) is used to declare variables in JavaScript.

question: Trace the output of following JavaScript code: var str='Information Technology'; document.write(str.lastIndexOf('o'));
explanation: The last occurrence of 'o' in 'Information Technology' is at zero-based index 19.

question: A ____________ is a set of instructions used to produce various kinds of outputs.
explanation: A program is an organized set of instructions executed by a computer.

question: Programs written in the JavaScript language are called ____________.
explanation: JavaScript programs embedded into web browsers are referred to as scripts.

question: JavaScript is known as the universal ____________ scripting language.
explanation: JavaScript is universally supported by web browsers as the client-side scripting standard.

question: In ____________ scripting, the script resides on the client computer.
explanation: Client-side scripts run directly in the user's web browser.

question: In ____________ scripting, the script resides on the web server.
explanation: Server-side scripts execute remotely on web servers before output is transmitted.

question: ____________ scripts are used primarily for input validation without wasting server time.
explanation: Client-side scripting enables instant browser-based form validation.

question: ____________ is a JavaScript-based open-source frontend web framework developed for single-page applications.
explanation: AngularJS is an open-source frontend web framework suited for SPAs.

question: ____________ is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces for single-page applications and mobile applications.
explanation: React is a JavaScript library dedicated to building reactive component UIs.

question: JavaScript has a built-in multiway decision statement known as ____________.
explanation: The switch statement evaluates an expression against multiple potential case matches.

question: The ____________ loop combines initialization, condition, and loop iteration into a single statement.
explanation: for(init; condition; iteration) encapsulates loop mechanics in one concise line.

question: The ____________ statement is used to jump out of a loop immediately.
explanation: The break statement breaks the enclosing loop cycle immediately.

question: When it is necessary to skip the statement block and take control to the beginning for the next iteration, the ____________ statement is used.
explanation: The continue statement skips the remaining loop body and proceeds to the next iteration.

question: The ____________ keyword is used to instantiate a new object in JavaScript.
explanation: The new operator creates instances of user-defined or built-in object types.

question: DOM stands for ____________.
explanation: DOM stands for Document Object Model.

question: The ____________ property of the DOM document object returns the <head> element.
explanation: document.head returns the head node of the current HTML document.

question: The ____________ property of the DOM document object sets or returns the title of the document.
explanation: document.title accesses or mutates the document's title tag string.

question: The ____________ method of the DOM document object writes HTML expressions or JavaScript code to a document.
explanation: document.write() writes raw text or HTML directly to an open document stream.

question: The ____________ method of the DOM document object is identical to write(), but adds a newline character after each statement.
explanation: writeln() appends a newline character to the written stream.

question: The ____________ property is useful for getting an HTML element and changing its content dynamically.
explanation: element.innerHTML gets or modifies HTML content nested inside an element.

question: The ____________ object is the parent object of all other objects in the browser hierarchy.
explanation: The window object represents the global browser execution context.

question: The ____________ property of the window object returns a boolean value indicating whether the window has been closed or not.
explanation: window.closed returns true if the referenced window has closed.

question: The ____________ method of the window object displays a dialog box to get text input from the user.
explanation: prompt() prompts the user with an input dialog and returns the text entered.

question: The ____________ method of the window object closes the current browser window.
explanation: window.close() closes the current or referenced window instance.

question: The ____________ method of the window object removes focus from the current window.
explanation: blur() removes focus from the element or window.

question: The ____________ method of the window object sets focus to the current window.
explanation: focus() brings the target window or input element into active focus.

question: The ____________ event occurs when an element loses its focus.
explanation: onblur triggers when a user leaves or shifts focus away from an element.

question: The ____________ event occurs when an element receives focus.
explanation: onfocus executes when an element becomes active.

question: The ____________ event occurs when a user changes the content of an element or selects a dropdown value.
explanation: onchange triggers upon value commit changes in inputs or select options.

question: The ____________ event occurs when a user clicks the form submit button.
explanation: onsubmit triggers before form submission.

question: The ____________ property of the Number object returns the largest minimum representable value.
explanation: Number.MIN_VALUE returns the smallest positive representable number in JavaScript.

question: The ____________ property of the Number object represents a 'Not-a-Number' value.
explanation: NaN indicates unrepresentable or invalid mathematical results.

question: The ____________ method of the Number object converts a given string into a floating-point number.
explanation: parseFloat() parses string arguments and returns floating-point numbers.

question: The ____________ method of the String object removes whitespace from both sides of a string.
explanation: trim() strips leading and trailing whitespace from string primitives.

question: The ____________ method of the String object converts a string to lowercase characters.
explanation: toLowerCase() converts all alphabet characters to lowercase.

question: The ____________ method of the Math object returns the next integer greater than or equal to a given number.
explanation: Math.ceil() rounds a numerical float up to the next integer.

question: The ____________ method of the Math object returns the next integer less than or equal to a given number.
explanation: Math.floor() rounds a numerical float down to the closest lower integer.

question: The ____________ method of the Date object returns the four-digit year.
explanation: getFullYear() returns the 4-digit calendar year (e.g., 2026).

question: The index of the first element in a JavaScript array is always ____________.
explanation: JavaScript arrays are zero-indexed, starting with index 0.

question: The ____________ method of the Array object removes the last element from an array and returns that element.
explanation: pop() removes the final element and decrements array length.

question: The ____________ method of the Array object adds new elements to the end of an array and returns the new length.
explanation: push() appends items to the end of an array.

question: Select TWO valid methods of the Date object:
explanation: setTime() and getTime() are built-in methods of the JavaScript Date object.

question: Select TWO valid properties of the DOM document object:
explanation: URL and title belong to document; status and name belong to window.

question: Select TWO event handlers used with text/form input objects in JavaScript:
explanation: onblur and onfocus manage active element focus changes.

question: Select the TWO fundamental types of scripting environments:
explanation: Web scripting is categorized into Client-side and Server-side architectures.

question: Select TWO looping control structures available in JavaScript:
explanation: for and while are standard JavaScript looping statements.

question: Select TWO categories of objects supported in JavaScript:
explanation: JavaScript supports native built-in objects as well as custom user-defined objects.

question: Select TWO built-in objects available in JavaScript:
explanation: Math and Array are built-in global objects. JavaScript has Date, not Time or Month.

question: Select TWO valid methods of the DOM document object:
explanation: write() and writeln() are methods; body and URL are properties.

question: Select TWO valid properties of the window object:
explanation: name and location are properties; alert() and confirm() are methods.

question: Select TWO valid methods of the window object:
explanation: open() and close() are window methods.

question: The confirm() method of the window object displays a confirmation box with which TWO buttons?
explanation: The browser confirm() dialog renders standard OK and Cancel buttons.

question: Select TWO valid event handlers in JavaScript:
explanation: onsubmit and onchange are event handlers; write/writeln are document methods.

question: Select TWO valid methods of the Math object:
explanation: Math.abs() and Math.random() are Math methods; substr and trim belong to String.

question: Select TWO properties of the Array object in JavaScript:
explanation: index and length are array properties; concat is an array method.

question: Select TWO methods of the Array object:
explanation: forEach() and Array.isArray() are Array methods.

question: Select THREE valid methods of the window object:
explanation: alert(), close(), and open() are window methods. write/writeln belong to document, and charAt to String.

question: Select THREE recognized features of JavaScript:
options: can handle date and time effectively
explanation: JavaScript supports event-driven architecture, built-in global objects, and native Date manipulation.

question: Select THREE built-in objects available in JavaScript:
explanation: Date, Array, and Number are standard built-in JavaScript object constructors.

question: Select THREE popular JavaScript frontend frameworks or libraries:
explanation: AngularJS, Vue.js, and React are modern JavaScript frontend web frameworks/libraries.

question: Select THREE properties of the DOM document object:
explanation: title, URL, and head are properties of the document object.

question: Select THREE valid properties of the Number object:
explanation: Number.MIN_VALUE, Number.MAX_VALUE, and Number.NaN are standard properties.

question: Select THREE valid methods of the Number object:
explanation: parseFloat(), isFixed(), and Number.isInteger() are Number methods.

question: Select THREE valid methods of the String object:
explanation: substr(), toLowerCase(), and indexOf() are String methods; length is a property.

question: Select THREE valid methods of the Math object:
explanation: Math.sqrt(), Math.random(), and Math.floor() are built-in Math methods.

question: Select THREE valid methods of the Date object:
explanation: getDay(), getHours(), and getTime() extract values from Date instances.

question: Select THREE valid methods of the Array object:
explanation: sort(), indexOf(), and forEach() are Array methods.
